d: Prime Minister Narendra Modi welcomed Prime Minister of Nepal Balendra Shah on his first bilateral visit to India, outlining a comprehensive roadmap to elevate bilateral ties. Highlighting shared civilisational roots, Modi noted, 'nepal ke bina hamare dham adhure hain. nepal ke bina hamare ram bhi adhure hain.' To support Nepal's recovery from devastating August floods and promote long-term development, he announced a 24,000 crore Nepali rupee Development Cooperation Package.
